conformer_pipeline.embedding_method: RDKit ETKDGv3 (useMacrocycleTorsions=True, useSmallRingTorsions=True, enforceChirality=True, heavy-atom embedding -> AddHs(addCoords=True))
conformer_pipeline.conformer_budget: numConfs=8 for MW < 1800 Da; numConfs=4 for MW >= 1800 Da
conformer_pipeline.force_field_relaxation: MMFF94s (maxIters=65 for n_heavy<=110 / 50 for >110) with UFF (maxIters=65 for n_heavy<=110 / 50 for >110) fallback
conformer_pipeline.imhb_definition: Intramolecular donor-acceptor (N-H/O-H to N/O) heavy-atom distance <= 3.3 A separated by >= 4 topological bonds (plus strict geometric H...A <= 2.5 A & D-H...A >= 110 deg)
conformer_pipeline.psa3d_definition: Lee-Richards 3D solvent-accessible polar surface area (rdFreeSASA) over N, O, and polar H atoms across conformer ensemble (min, max, mean, chameleonic span = max - min)

PAMPA.description: Release-cohort split (non-SweMacrocycleDB historical train -> SweMacrocycleDB 2024-2025 + 2025-2026 JMC/ACSMCL test; exact compound dedup)

LogD7.4.description: Release-cohort split (historical Naylor/PEGASUS/ChEMBL train -> 2025-2026 Chloroalkene/JMC test; exact compound dedup)

honest_summary.zero_peeking_protocol: Holdout promotion strictly gated on OOF MAE improvement > 0; both gate-passing and non-passing holdout deltas are reported transparently.
